links.comparator_used: Discrimination-only assessment (AUROC/AUPRC) of the same model, internally versus externally
links.outcome: Detection of performance drift under external deployment (calibration versus discrimination)
links.effect: Internal AUROC 0.847 vs external AUROC 0.819, so discrimination held up. Internal calibration was near-ideal (slope 0.982; intercept 0.001), but external validation showed systematic risk overestimation (intercept -0.678). An intercept-only adjustment reduced ECE by 26%.
links.quote: ICU mortality models exhibit transportable discrimination but clinically significant calibration drift under cross-institutional deployment.
